v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum habitáre fratres in unum. ‡
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. ‡

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

text.la: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Ierúsalem.
text.en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

text.la: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
text.en: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

text.la: Mulíerem fortem quis invéniet? Procul et de últimis fínibus prétium eius. Confídit in ea cor viri sui, et spóliis non indigébit.
text.en: Who shall find a valiant woman? Far and from the uttermost coasts is the price of her. The heart of her husband trusteth in her, and he shall have no need of spoils.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Manum suam * apéruit ínopi, et palmas suas exténdit ad páuperem, et panem otiósa non comédit.
text.en: She spreadeth out her hand to the poor, * yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

text.la: Tuórum corda fidélium, Deus miserátor, illústra: et, beátæ Elísabeth précibus gloriósis; fac nos próspera mundi despícere, et cælésti semper consolatióne gaudére.
text.en: Enlighten, O God of mercy, the hearts of thy faithful people, and by the glorious prayers of thy blessed handmaid Elizabeth, make us to set little store by the good things of this world, and to rejoice ever in thy heavenly comfort.
